Series 10k to sensor DO and 18k to GND. Nominal 3.214V from 5V rail: 86mV BELOW VCC=3.3V so the input protection diode never approaches conduction. Worst case with 5% parts and 5.25V rail: 3.494V (absolute max 3.80V) and 2.943V (VIH min 2.31V). A 10k/20k pair was planned for the final build but sits 33mV ABOVE VCC and leaves only 190mV of headroom: 10k/18k is recommended for the final build too. Each DO channel needs its own divider: ~180uA per channel and ~1.6mA for nine. Thevenin impedance ~6.4k limits clamp current to ~390uA if the HC165 is unpowered while DO is at 5V
